summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` lifecycle hook that runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime binary from GitHub releases (`https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/...zip`), extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and immediately invokes it via `execFileSync` against the sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB Bun-compiled bundle marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` with a rotating string array (`WV8StW` rotator, `n7gIxM` mixed hex/string constant array) and hex-mangled identifiers; its contents cannot be inspected without executing Bun. The package's advertised purpose is Vue regex components, and `math_init.js` is not referenced from `index.js` or any documented API — the file exists only to be executed at install time by the downloaded alien runtime. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: install-time execution of a hidden obfuscated payload via a freshly downloaded non-Node runtime, which evades Node-based supply-chain scanners and hides the payload from static inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
